summary.name: WikiSuite
summary.one_liner: WikiSuite is a free/open-source enterprise software suite that bundles many upstream components, and this page is a source-code index linking to their repositories.
use_cases: Browsing source code of WikiSuite components
Finding upstream projects bundled in WikiSuite
Locating repositories for Tiki, Dolibarr, or Openfire integrations
summary.what_it_does: The page is a source-code index for WikiSuite, an open source enterprise suite. It links to the repositories of its main components, including Tiki wiki, Tiki Manager, Virtualmin, Dolibarr, MeshCentral, BigBlueButton, Syncthing, Manticore Search, Openfire-related plugins, FreeSWITCH, and Xibo. It also lists code the project has upstreamed, such as Bootstrap conversions, a jQuery Gantt editor update, and Converse.js work. The page states that WikiSuite works with upstream projects to add features there rather than only in its own fork. For installation instructions, the page refers readers to a separate install guide.
notable: Bundles many upstream open source projects, with a policy of upstreaming changes first
Links to Black Duck Open Hub for code statistics
Components licensed under GPL-3.0, LGPL-2.1, Apache-2.0, MPL, MIT, and AGPL-3.0 per awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: This page covers source code only; installation is documented separately
Platform list is inferred from the awesome-selfhosted listing (Shell/Perl/deb) and is not stated explicitly on the page
